material_systems.name: Flat Ceiling Paint
material_systems.description: Standard flat/matte ceiling paint for NC production. Hides imperfections, no glare, economical.

example_products: PPG Manor Hall Flat Ceiling Paint
products.notes: Flat sheen hides ceiling imperfections and eliminates glare. Fast dry, easy touch-up.

material_systems.name: Premium Flat Ceiling Paint
material_systems.description: Premium flat ceiling paint for QT4 work. Two coats for colored ceilings or enhanced coverage. No sheen penalty.

example_products: Benjamin Moore Regal Select Ceiling Paint
products.notes: Premium flat for colored ceilings or enhanced coverage. Two coats provide uniform color depth and hide. Forgiving application.

material_systems.name: Eggshell/Satin Ceiling Paint
material_systems.description: Eggshell or satin ceiling paint for QT4 work. Beautiful sheen, more washable. Sheen application penalty applies.

example_products: Benjamin Moore Regal Select Ceiling Eggshell
products.notes: Eggshell provides beautiful sheen and better washability. Two coats required. Shows imperfections more than flat - careful application required.

material_systems.name: Semi-Gloss Ceiling Paint
material_systems.description: Semi-gloss or higher ceiling paint for QT5 work. Maximum washability, moisture resistance. Critical prep required - shows every imperfection.

products.notes: Semi-gloss+ finish is unforgiving - every imperfection shows. Critical inspection and prep required. Two coats mandatory.

coverage_profiles.assumptions: Primed drywall ceiling, proper application thickness
Textured surface increases surface area, reduces coverage
Premium flat paint, two coat system for colored ceilings
Premium flat paint on textured surface, two coat system
Eggshell paint on textured surface, two coat system
Semi-gloss paint, two coat system. Smooth surfaces only recommended for semi-gloss+.
Semi-gloss paint on textured surface. Textured ceilings with semi-gloss are uncommon - verify specification.

material_quantity_notes.paint_calculation: Ceiling SF × number of coats ÷ coverage rate = gallons needed
material_quantity_notes.coat_count: QT2-QT3 = 1 coat flat; QT4 = 2 coats eggshell; QT5 = 2 coats semi-gloss+
material_quantity_notes.consumable_calculation: Driven by application method and room/opening counts
material_quantity_notes.qt5_note: QT5 semi-gloss+ requires critical prep - additional sanding/inspection time not reflected in material quantities
